purpose: Regression probe: a Claude-generated Traditional Chinese research proposal that every text engine missed in production (2026-10-21).

document.label: ai
document.generator: Claude (exported by Claude Docs; app.xml Application=Claude Docs)
document.domain: academic_zh (two-year research proposal, ~25k chars, English (Author, Year) citations, tables)

contract: per-sentence, max_len=192, evidence = any sentence >= threshold (scored with evaluate_known_documents.py)
conclusion: Not a threshold or chunking problem: the classifier confidently scores this register as human at every granularity. Training data covers DeepSeek-V3, Gemini-2.5-Flash, GPT-4o and Qwen-Max on news/QA/assistant registers only; no Claude and no long-form Chinese academic writing. A weak-direction channel for silent engines would have pushed this document toward human, so silence-as-no-vote is kept.
next_step: Generate zh_proposal / zh_review / zh_light_edit samples with binoculars/generate_ai_corpus.py (Claude plus at least one other provider), pair them with topic-matched human Chinese academic writing as hard negatives, retrain, and require this probe plus a held-out academic set to clear the threshold without raising human FPR above 1%.
